Or, any combination of education and experience which would provide the required equivalent qualifications for the position.

items.item_text: 01. How have you demonstrated sensitivity to and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, geographic, gender, gender identity, and ethnic backgrounds of community college students?

02. This role supports a department with 18 classified staff and temporary employees across several auxiliary services (Swap Meet, facility rentals, reprographics, mail room). Describe how you would prioritize and track administrative requests coming from that many different functions at once.
03. Describe a time you had to support operations happening outside normal business hours (weekends, evenings) or coordinate with staff who are not on a typical 8-5 schedule.
04. Describe a time a supervisor was unavailable (e.g., working a weekend event) and you had to make a judgment call or handle something administrative independently.
05. Describe a situation where you had to communicate time-sensitive information to multiple people quickly, for example, a schedule change, closure, or emergency notification.

06. This is an in-house-only recruitment: This position is open to internal permanent and temporary employees of the Coast Community College District (CCCD). External candidates are NOT eligible to apply. If you are not a current CCCD employee, please do not apply at this time. Are you currently employed by the Coast Community College District as an active employee? Options: Yes | No

08. I understand that a COMPLETE application packet is required for consideration, which includes the following: 1. A completed Coast Community College District Online Employment Application 2. A current resume (uploaded as a separate attachment - PDF recommended) 3. A cover letter (uploaded as a separate attachment - PDF recommended) 4. Responses to supplemental questions (clear and detailed responses required, as they will be carefully evaluated to determine the most qualified candidate(s) to be invited for an interview; please do not paste your resume, or put "see resume", or "N/A" or leave blank) Options: Yes | No

09. Please confirm that all responses provided in this application are your own original work and were not generated or assisted by artificial intelligence tools or software. By answering 'Yes,' you attest to the authenticity of your responses. Options: Yes | No
May require a valid driver's license.

The position requires one year of post-secondary education in a business profession and three years of experience in an administrative support capacity. An Associate's degree is preferred and will substitute for some experience.
An Associate's degree is preferred and will substitute for some experience.
Or, any combination of education and experience which would provide the required equivalent qualifications for the position.
Work is performed indoors where minimal safety considerations exist.

Evidence of demonstrated sensitivity to and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, geographic, gender, gender identity, and ethnic backgrounds of community college students. (California Code of Regulations Title 553022; Education Code Section 87360; Coast Community College District EEO Plan)
